verdict.rationale: Virtualization support is a fair question for a desktop CPU, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents virtualization extensions (e.g., VT-x/VT-d), hypervisor compatibility, or Docker/container workflows on this chip. The vPro Enterprise eligibility and ECC entries are adjacent platform features and do not state virtualization support.

support.subject: As a developer, VMs and containers run well on this silicon — documented virtualization support and mainstream hypervisor and Docker workflows
